I find the story of the Snow Elves and Falmer fascinating, on top of so many others.

Snow elves are ancient descendants of the Aldmer, but they retained much of the culture from them unlike some other descendants. They were the only Mer to settle down in Skyrim and remain there with a few Dwemer. When the Atmoran's arrive, they created a relationship with them, for a short time.

One night, they attacked the Atmoran City of Saarthal, leaving only the leader, Ysgramor and his two sons alive, all forresources and territory that the "nords" were taking away from them. The once peaceful race, turned into a power hungry trip that ended up costing them their race.

For a short time they were OK, until Ysgramor returned with his Five-hjundred Companions and took revenge on the Snow Elves, almost making them extinct. They sought refuge in Solstheim for a short time. But during the Battle od Morsring, their leader died. This broke down the Snow Elves even more, and they lost the war. Being slaughtered at every turn, they scattered, and some tried to get other alliances in Skyrim only to be slaughtered where they stood or just straight up disappeared.

Fast forwards now to their only last standing alliance with the Dwermer, out of desperation, many Snow Elves accepted a new life of slavery to stay alive but didn't know what would happen to their once great race. After time, they devolved into the Falmer and eventually revolted, starting a war that lasted Decades. But then, the Drewmer disappeared. Poof. This made the Falmer free again, but at a cost.

They aren't the noble race they once were anymore. They wanted blood and violence, since that's all they had known for the longest time. But now that everything calmed down (except for dragons now), the remaining snow elves, show pity on their blind brethren. The remaining elves gathered at the Chairity of Auri-El until the Falmer attacked them, and only two, Knight-Paladin Delebor and his brother Arch-Curate Vyrthur survived.

It's unclear if they're the last two Snow Elves too, since they scattered everywhere to escape the Nords from slaughtering them.
